tests.name: Consolidated schema and four sealed snapshots execute
Employment initially has no known end
Later discovery admits a departure
Date correction retains the same engagement identity
Rehire is a second engagement with a preserved gap
Contemporaneous knowledge does not see later rehire
Actual leave event has corrected occurrence at latest K
Repo made-public and hosted release remain separate events
Repo archival becomes true at its exact half-open boundary
Archival discovery delay uses event encounter, not repo discovery
Advance discovery has negative delay and explicit scheduled mode
Uncertain occurrence yields bounded delay and no fabricated scalar
One year ago features use immutable initial specification
Six months ago features include revised spec and search
Two months ago features include third scoped capability
Older knowledge snapshot never leaks later feature admissions
Pro plan does not imply features in an unknown free-plan scope
Historical support is admitted at old K and withdrawn at new K
Old packet retains original publication and unchanged chunk after withdrawal
Cross-tenant history query returns no foreign segments
Old segment mutation is rejected
Captured chunk mutation is rejected
Adding segment to sealed revision is rejected
Adding publication member after seal is rejected
Adding packet member after recorded run is rejected
A feature cannot belong to a different product by ID accident
A feature cannot borrow another feature specification
Typed payload cannot be attached to the wrong stream kind
Payload from another engagement cannot attach to valid segment
Missing typed payload prevents batch seal
Overlapping states within one revision are rejected
An empty replacement does not revive old accepted segments
NULL stream cannot bypass composite foreign-key enforcement
NULL relationship endpoint cannot bypass typed identity enforcement

limitations: No concurrent writer, production RLS, authorization, idempotency or full evidence admission proof
Current queries assume validated snapshot and scope; absence requires API coverage/unknown response
